Physical GPU Lanes

Each lane is one physical CUDA device. TP=2 × PP=4 therefore has two sibling device lanes per pipeline stage; TP=1 × PP=8 has one.

Five-Millisecond Kernel Time Density

Event durations are split across every 5 ms bin they overlap. Event counts remain assigned to their launch bin.

Expanded family residency across eight GPUs

The dashed line is the simple 40 GPU-ms device-time baseline per 5 ms wall-clock bin.

Same-device overlap can make summed event residency exceed the baseline. This is not a utilization percentage.
